# The Grid Nexus

> The Grid Nexus is the trust layer for gamers — plain-language gaming security. Check what's safe, recover a stolen account fast, and stay ahead of the next threat. Every grade, verdict and recovery guide links to verified official sources, never asks for credentials, and is re-dated when reviewed.

## What this site is

The Grid Nexus (https://thegridnexus.com) publishes player-first gaming security intelligence:

- **Security grades** — per-game and per-platform account-security grades based on documented 2FA support, official domains, and known breach history.
- **"Is it safe?" verdicts** — a structured database of verdicts (safe / cautious / avoid) on games, mods, cheat tools, skin sites, key resellers, VPNs and other download-and-trade surfaces.
- **Gamer threat report** — CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities triaged by a transparent "gamer impact" score.
- **Account recovery navigator** — step-by-step official recovery guides for Steam, Discord, Epic, EA, Riot Games, PlayStation and Xbox.
- **Free tools** — a Scam Checker (paste a link/message → verdict), a gaming security checkup, and a download checker.

All guidance is document-based, cites primary sources, and never pretends to be a live device or account audit.
